title: The same escalation with a checkpointer wired: operator approval executes the call through the supported API
note: R06 (approve leg). The runner answers the await_human_input event via InMemoryCheckpointer.respond(traceId, promptId, "yes") — the supported approval API — and the escalated call then executes exactly once. Only the binding actually exercised here is claimed: an in-process approval within the run's own event loop.
